title: Cascade works on the Invoicing & payments card when See Financial Data is ON
custom_preconds:
1. See Financial Data is ON.
  2. In the Invoicing & payments card, all boxes are unticked.
custom_expected: View, Create & Edit and Delete all become ticked. (The delete level here is labelled Delete / Reverse.)
evidence: UI: with SFD ON, Invoicing & payments tick Create&Edit cascades View ON, no SFD dialog.
